caption: The video depicts a faceted glass tumbler filled with dark purple liquid resting in a pale rectangular tray on a light wooden tabletop. A metal spoon leans against the left inner wall, and a thin wooden stick with a small purple sphere at its base stands in the liquid, passing through a slot in a flat cardboard piece held at the top edge. A second hand steadies the glass while the cardboard tilts upwards above the rim, then is lifted out of view, after which the steadying hand releases the glass and moves to the right. The wooden stick remains upright throughout, its sphere staying submerged near the center. The slotted cardboard returns into the top of the frame at an angle, the stick still threaded through its slot. The spoon shifts slightly, leaning more upright against the inner wall as the glass is left unsupported. The tray, glass and wooden background keep fixed positions under a stationary camera.
